title: Wat Bang Phra
geometryBasis: The precise OpenStreetMap temple area validates the site. The central crossed roof and adjacent rectangular roof come from two identified Overture buildings orthogonal to the same forecourt.
sectionBasis: The exact public-domain image fixes the stepped red-tile roofs, tall gilded spire, chofa silhouette, standing golden figure and ornamented gables. Exterior heights, approach and figure location use approximate sections on the original riverside terrain.
limitations: The exact named temple area is mapped. The assignment of the photographed hall and neighbor to their roof outlines, roof rises, placement of the standing figure, and intricate gilded relief are photo-guided estimates.
The model represents the temple exterior shown in the reference and its adjoining roof. Remaining compound buildings and interiors are outside the authored scope.
